about.title: About Elementaction
about.p1: Elementaction gathers board sports in one place: event calendars, articles, design and videos for surfing, skateboarding and snowboarding, plus design, photography and travel in the Inspiration section.
about.p2: It started as skateboardeventcalendar.com, a global calendar of skateboard contests. The skateboard calendar lives on here, now joined by surf and snow.
about.p3: Every event is checked against a real source before it is added: the organizer's own site, an official calendar or a news report. The source is linked at the bottom of each event page. Articles list their sources too.
about.p4: Elementaction is built and run by Martin Björck in Helsingborg, Sweden.
about.contactBody: Found an error, missing an event or have a question? Open an issue on GitHub. It is the fastest way to reach us.
